<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/generate_user_ssh_key/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a passphrase-less key pair at `users/<name>/ssh_key` and points
the user's profile at it.

Passphrase-less because nothing can type one: the key is used by
unattended git operations (GITutils authenticates every push and pull as
the acting user), so a passphrase would simply mean nothing works. That is
what the file permissions and the gitignore entry are protecting.

Repointing the profile is part of the job rather than a separate save -
generating a key and not using it is never what was wanted, and it means
the key works even if the operator closes the dialog without saving. An
existing key is refused unless `overwrite` is set, so a working key is
never replaced by a stray double-click.
